Each version below is a published PC printing (card image or errata sheet slip); card-image dates given below are the documented PC image-repository revision dates (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later), slip dates are the errata sheet's PDF date. Every visibly different printing is a separate version, and an errata sheet slip is a version of its own, separate from the card image of the same errata (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' compared with the previous version (the high-resolution image of 10 August 2021; left = before, right = after): [[File:V6-L-rogueone_ai-2022-01-15-vs-hires-2021-08-10-changes.png|frameless|upright=2]].
